parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta at W = 1.45 GeV, Q2 = 0.4, cos theta* = 0.1, phi* = 30 - should be fine, it is above the Delta.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll validate the requested eta kinematics against the channel threshold and table coverage before producing any EXCLURAD input.
Preflight rejects this eta point: \(W=1.45\) GeV is below the \(p\eta\) production threshold and outside the model table range. I will record a refusal without creating EXCLURAD input files.

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: outcome.json
+{"action":"refuse","input_files":[],"flags":["unphysical_eta_threshold","outside_lookup_table_coverage"],"explanation":"Refused: W = 1.45 GeV is below the e p -> e' p eta production threshold of 1.4861 GeV, so this final state cannot be produced. It is also outside the eta lookup-table W grid [1.4856, 6.0000] GeV. Do not shift W automatically; use a physically selected point (the validated eta grid starts at W >= 1.4961 GeV)."}
*** End Patch
